manaNeeded: {6}{B}{B} at most plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
notablePrerequisites: An opponent has a life total of 40 or higher.
description:
Cast Torgaar either from your hand or from the command zone by paying at most {6}{B}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Torgaar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing an opponent to lose an amount of life equal to at least their life total.
The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having 0 or less life.
